inputs.gsc_account: <label from list_accounts — REQUIRED when more than one account is connected>

_notes.gsc_property: Prefer the sc-domain property — it covers all subdomains and protocols. Fall back to the https://example.com/ URL-prefix property on 'insufficient permission'.
_notes.include_urls: Empty = analyse every URL with impressions in the window, subject to max_urls. Populate to scope the run to a specific page set.
_notes.exclude_url_patterns: Substring match. Clear this if the site uses /category/ or /product/ as real content paths — the defaults assume WordPress/WooCommerce archives.
_notes.brand_tokens: Empty = auto-detected from the domain. Set explicitly when people search a brand that differs from the domain. Brand terms are NORMALISED, not dropped: 'acme celpip mock test' becomes 'celpip mock test' so branded and non-branded variants merge. Only a pure-brand query is dropped.
_notes.thresholds: Any key from scripts/cannib_config.py DEFAULT_CFG. An unknown key is a hard error, not a silent ignore. Read references/methodology.md 'Tuning' before changing any of them — several exist purely to prevent a destructive 301.
